rv.q: Bertelsen’s skillful direction succeeds at this and maintains the intensity.
Sam Shepard’s Pulitzer Prize-winning drama about a rural Illinois family beset by delusion and dysfunction is brilliantly brought to life by AstonRep Theatre Company.
This is a production that may dwell in our dreams and torment theatergoers long time after the final curtain.
This play has it all, suspense, intrigue and fast moving with an excellent cast of actors.

cn.t: AstonRep delivers a sharply directed, brilliantly acted production of Shepard's dark Pulitzer winner about a dysfunctional Illinois family, with stellar performances bringing the bleak, haunting drama to vivid life.
